reuse.why: Hooks into the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked pre-check and the shared linkBankSyncAccount, which every provider uses, rather than touching each provider.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written twice, once as a pre-check in assertBankAccountNotLinked and again inside linkBankSyncAccount after the bank is created, with only the error string shared.

placement.why: The closed rule is put inside a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked, whose name and purpose are about duplicate links, and is repeated in the shared link writer.

scope.why: Only the rule, a test block and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: Two copies of the same rule in two layers, one hidden behind a misleading function name, leave a maintainer unsure which is authoritative.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicate is an open repetition of the closed check (assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount), not a disguised one.

one_place.where: The closed-account check is applied both in assertBankAccountNotLinked and in linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts; only the message constant is shared.
